codes.authProviderConflict: Another plugin already owns the sign-in provider "{provider}". Uninstall that plugin first.
codes.dataRestoreUnconfirmed: This rollback restores the plugin's data from a snapshot and discards what it saved since. Confirm it in the rollback dialog first.
codes.dataSnapshotDeclined: The upgrade was cancelled: there was no room for a snapshot of its data, which stays at version {from} and was not moved to {to}.
codes.dataVersionAhead: Its data was upgraded by version {applied}. Update the plugin to version {applied} or later, or clear its data before running version {current}.
codes.dependencyInUse: Other plugins depend on it: {dependents}. Disable or uninstall them first.
codes.dependencyMissing: It needs plugins that aren't enabled: {dependencies}.
codes.dirtyRuntime: Its last run didn't shut down cleanly. Retry the cleanup from the plugin's details first.
codes.frontendTrust: It runs unsandboxed code in the app. Trust it in the plugin's Permissions section to load it.
codes.incompatible: It can't run on this device.
codes.intentDisabled: It's turned off. Enable it first.
codes.managerNotReady: Plugins are still starting. Try again in a moment.
codes.pythonDependenciesNotReady: Its Python dependencies are {state, select, preparing {still being prepared} failed {not ready: the last preparation failed} stale {out of date} needsUv {waiting for uv, which its uv.lock needs and is not installed} other {not installed yet}}. Prepare them, then enable it again.
codes.pythonDisabled: The Python runtime is turned off on this device.
codes.uninstallMirrored: Uninstall it in the desktop app. This device only mirrors it.
codes.vscodeTrust: No Open VSX signature vouches for this VS Code extension. Trust it in the plugin's Permissions section to start it.

installRollback: Couldn't roll back {pluginName} after install failure
